Name: Obed-edom
Summary: Obed-edom is named in 2 Chronicles only as the man with whom the vessels of the house of God were found when Joash of Israel took them; the book does not state whether he is the Obed-edom of David's day.
KeyStory: Joash of Israel took all the vessels found in the house of God with Obed-edom, and the treasures of the king's house, and returned to Samaria.
LifeLesson: Temple treasures entrusted to one man can be carried off in a single defeat.
